title: Similar Triangles and Constant Slope Core Test
description: Use similar triangles to explain why slope is constant along a nonvertical line.

questions.questionText: A line has one slope triangle with rise 5 and run 2, and a larger slope triangle with rise 10 and run 4. What does this show?
options: Similar slope triangles cannot be used to find slope
questions.explanation: Similar slope triangles have proportional rise and run, so the ratio rise/run stays the same.

questions.questionText: Two slope triangles on the same line are similar. The small triangle is rise 10, run 6; the large triangle is rise 30, run 18. What slope do both give?
options: Similar slope triangles cannot be used to find slope
questions.explanation: Similar slope triangles have proportional rise and run, so the ratio rise/run stays the same.
